bundle.longDescription: Skidbladnir converts images to WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL and HEIC. For a still image it offers every option of cwebp, avifenc (libaom), cjxl and heif-enc with Kvazaar, and writes the same bytes those tools write, apart from a few documented cases. It reads PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, HEIC, GIF, PNM and PFM, converts animated GIF and WebP to animated WebP, keeps colour profiles and metadata the way each tool does, and previews the result before anything is written.
